description: Independent keyed latch with trigger, hold and rearm events
outputs: Reports a boolean only on first activation per identifier; repeating a trigger has no effect until that key resets.

description: Iterate plain tab-delimited records, preserving source order
outputs: Invoke a callback with the one-based line number and vector of string fields. Handles CRLF, empty cells and a final unterminated line.

description: FIFO reconciliation between two sides, grouped by a caller-defined key
outputs: Match one occurrence to the earliest pending opposite occurrence. Return outstanding input positions in numeric order.

description: Validate a declared prerequisite graph and schedule topological layers
outputs: Alphabetically sorted groups of simultaneously ready vertices. Reject cycles and unknown references.

description: Stream a gzip member sequence through zlib to a binary destination
outputs: Inflate concatenated gzip members in order and reject truncation or corrupt checksums.

description: Generic cancellable FIFO queue with unique membership
outputs: Push if absent, cancel by value, pop oldest as optional; removed items can be added again.

description: Save an ordered range of strings or signed integers as a JSON array
outputs: Preserve order, escape strings and emit an empty array for an empty collection.
